name: pulseboard
description: A customizable HetrixTools status page and admin dashboard for Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: node --check worker.js && node --check src/productApp.js && npm run build

CONFIG.description: Create or select the KV namespace used to store custom public status page settings.

LOGOS.description: Create or select the R2 bucket used for public status page logo uploads.

HETRIXTOOLS_API_KEY.description: Add your HetrixTools API v3 key as a Worker secret for public status pages.

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Set the username used to sign in to /admin (the temporary local default is admin).

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Set the password used to sign in to /admin (the temporary local default is admin).

DASHBOARD_SESSION_SECRET.description: Generate a random string for signing the HttpOnly admin session cookie, for example with openssl rand -hex 32.
